title: 붙여넣기 단어 제외와 상단 분석 버튼

criteria.selection: Native browser text selection maps to exact UTF-16 start/end with selected text fingerprint. Range toggle excludes/restores only selected characters, preserves newlines and neighboring quantities. Cross-panel selections and stale text ranges are ignored. Editing original clears ranges. Legacy numeric line exclusions remain supported by helper.
criteria.consumers: AI input, base-stock matching and projected draft use textWithoutExcludedLines. Exclusion changes invalidate previous analyzed orders. No AI call or ERP write on selection.
criteria.layout: 1920x1080: larger first grid row, analyze button in sticky input header. Smaller responsive layouts retain the same header button.

crossYearFixture.description: Text filtering preserves year/week headers outside the exact selected range and never changes selected ERP year.

dnspyEvidence.note: UI-only draft filtering; existing ERP saving and native methods unchanged.
